info.title: Multiroom Audio Hub v2 API
info.description: Professional REST API v2 for real-time multi-room audio routing. Provides full CRUD for inputs, output volume/mute control, route lifecycle management, instant URI-based playback, and idempotent master mute control.

tags.name: Inputs
tags.description: Audio input lifecycle management — create, list, retrieve, and delete ephemeral inputs

tags.name: Master Mute
tags.description: System-wide master mute control — silence all audio outputs

tags.name: Extensions
tags.description: Inventory of discovered extensions — what loaded, what didn't, and why

tags.name: Playback
tags.description: Instant URI-based audio playback — create ephemeral input and route in one call

tags.name: Outputs
tags.description: Audio output management — list outputs, control volume and mute state

tags.name: Groups
tags.description: Audio output group management — list groups and control group volume

tags.name: Routes
tags.description: Audio route lifecycle — create, list, retrieve, stop, and transfer routes

put.summary: Set pause state on a route
put.description: Pauses or resumes audio playback for an active route. Set paused=true to pause, paused=false to resume. Idempotent — setting the same state returns 200 OK with the current state.

400.description: Route not active, input does not support pause, or validation error

put.description: Sets the volume level for an audio output. Returns the applied volume in the response.
Mutes or unmutes an audio output. Returns the applied mute state.
Enables or disables an audio output. A disabled output remains registered but is unavailable for new route creation. Existing active routes are unaffected.

get.description: Returns the current global mute state. When active, all audio outputs are silenced.

put.description: Sets the global mute state. PUT is idempotent — same request repeated produces the same result.
Enables or disables an audio input. A disabled input remains registered but is unavailable for new route creation. Existing active routes are unaffected.

put.summary: Set volume for all outputs in a group
put.description: Sets the volume level for every output in the specified group.

put.summary: Mute or unmute all outputs in a group
put.description: Sets the mute state for every output in the specified group. Idempotent — setting the same state returns 200 OK with the current state.
Enables or disables an output group. A disabled group remains registered but is unavailable for new route creation. Existing active routes are unaffected.

get.description: Returns all current routes with their input, target, and status. Supports optional query parameters for filtering by status, inputId, and targetId (AND logic).

parameters.name: targetId
parameters.description: Filter by target output or group ID

post.description: Routes audio from an input to a target output or group. Resolves the target based on targetType (SINGLE_OUTPUT or OUTPUT_GROUP).

404.description: Input, output, or group not found

delete.summary: Stop every currently active route system-wide
delete.description: Stops all active routes regardless of target. Idempotent — if no routes are active, succeeds with stoppedCount 0. Best-effort: a route that fails to stop individually does not fail the whole request. This endpoint has no server-side confirmation gate; any client exposing it to an end user is responsible for confirming with that user first.

200.description: Stop-all completed (possibly with zero routes stopped)

post.summary: Transfer an active route to a new output or group
post.description: Seamlessly moves audio playback to a new target without interruption. The old route is replaced — callers must update their references to the new routeId.

400.description: Validation error or route not transferable

post.description: Provides instant playback: supply a URI and target, and the system automatically creates an ephemeral input and route. Supports YouTube, SoundCloud, and other URI schemes. If volume is provided, it is set before playback starts.

get.description: Returns all inputs. By default only enabled inputs are returned; use includeDisabled=true to include disabled inputs.

parameters.name: includeDisabled
parameters.description: Include disabled inputs in the response

post.summary: Create a new ephemeral audio input
post.description: Registers an ephemeral audio input that can be routed to outputs. Returns 201 with a Location header pointing to the created resource.

202.description: Request accepted; audio exists and is queued to play

400.description: Invalid request, unknown target, or unknown provider

503.description: Provider unavailable, errored, or returned an unconvertible format

get.summary: Get a single route by ID
get.description: Returns the route with its current status and timestamps.

delete.description: Stops audio playback and removes the route. Ephemeral inputs with autoRemove=true are cleaned up automatically.

get.description: Returns all outputs with current volume and mute state. By default only enabled outputs are returned.

parameters.name: includeDisabled
parameters.description: Include disabled outputs in the response

get.summary: Get a single output by ID
get.description: Returns the output with current volume and mute state.

get.summary: Get a single input by ID
get.description: Returns the input if it exists.

delete.description: Removes a previously registered ephemeral input. Static (YAML-configured) inputs cannot be deleted.

400.description: Input is a static (YAML-configured) input and cannot be deleted

get.description: Returns all groups with their member output IDs. By default only enabled groups are returned.

parameters.name: includeDisabled
parameters.description: Include disabled groups in the response

get.summary: Get a single group by ID
get.description: Returns the group with its member output IDs.
Returns the inventory captured at start-up: every extension JAR found, including rejected ones, with its status and (for REJECTED) the reason.

delete.summary: Stop every route associated with a single output
delete.description: Stops routes addressed directly to this output, and any group route whose group currently includes this output as a member (the whole group route is stopped, since a single output cannot be detached from a live group route). Idempotent and best-effort, matching DELETE /api/v2/routes semantics.

200.description: Stop completed (possibly with zero routes stopped)

delete.summary: Stop every route associated with a group
delete.description: Stops routes addressed directly to this group, and any route addressed directly to one of the group's member outputs. Idempotent and best-effort, matching DELETE /api/v2/routes semantics.

200.description: Stop completed (possibly with zero routes stopped)

PauseRequest.description: Request body for setting pause state on a route

paused.description: true to pause playback, false to resume playback

type.description: Static URN identifying the error type

title.description: Short, stable title for the error type

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of this specific error

instance.description: Request URI that caused this error

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when error occurred

startedAt.description: Timestamp when audio began playing (nullable before playback starts)

transferable.description: Whether route can be transferred to another target

pauseable.description: Whether the input driving this route supports pause/resume

VolumeRequest.description: Request body for setting volume level

OutputVolumeResponse.description: Confirmation of applied volume level for an output

outputId.description: The output ID that was modified

volume.description: The volume level that was applied (0-100)

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when volume was set

MuteRequest.description: Request body for setting mute state

muted.description: true to mute, false to unmute

OutputMuteResponse.description: Confirmation of applied output mute state

outputId.description: The output ID that was modified

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when mute state was set

EnabledRequest.description: Set the enabled state of an audio input

enabled.description: Whether the input should be enabled

OutputResponse.description: Audio output device details with current volume and mute state

enabled.description: Whether output is enabled for new route creation

muted.description: true if master mute is active, false if unmuted

InputResponse.description: Audio input details with source and creation metadata

GroupVolumeResponse.description: Confirmation of applied volume level for a group

groupId.description: The group ID that was modified

volume.description: The volume level that was applied (0-100)

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when volume was set

GroupMuteResponse.description: Confirmation of applied group mute state

groupId.description: The group ID that was modified

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when mute state was set

GroupResponse.description: Audio output group with member output IDs

muted.description: Whether all member outputs are muted

enabled.description: Whether group is enabled for new route creation

CreateRouteRequest.description: Request body for creating an audio route

targetId.description: ID of the destination output or group

TransferRequest.description: Request body for transferring a route to a new target

targetId.description: ID of the destination output or group

PlaybackRequest.description: Request body for instant URI-based playback

targetId.description: ID of the destination output or group

displayName.description: Optional friendly name for the ephemeral input

volume.description: Optional volume level (0-100), set before playback starts

PlaybackResponse.description: Playback result with ephemeral input and route details

message.description: Success message describing the playback state

CreateInputRequest.description: Request body for creating a new ephemeral audio input

inputId.description: Unique identifier for the input (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores, 1-255 chars)

uri.description: Source URI (http://, file://, alsa://, signal://, etc.)

enabled.description: Whether input is active (defaults to true)

autoRemove.description: Auto-remove input when its route is stopped (defaults to false)

BulkStopResponse.description: Result of a scoped stop-routes operation

stoppedCount.description: Equal to stoppedRoutes.length; convenience for callers that don't need detail

stoppedRoutes.description: The routes that were in scope and had a stop attempted

StoppedRouteEntry.description: One route that was in scope and had a stop attempted

stopReason.description: Why the route fell within the requested stop scope
